name: takio
description: A lightweight, modern desktop, TUI, and CLI alternative to Calibre

scripts.build: cargo build --release -p takio && bun run --filter '@takio/core' build && bun run --filter '@takio/epub-transform' build && bun run --filter '@takio/library-contract' build && bun run --filter '@takio/library-store-bun' build && bun run --filter '@takio/desktop' build
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy -p takio --all-targets -- -D warnings && bun run --filter '@takio/core' check && bun run --filter '@takio/epub-transform' check && bun run --filter '@takio/library-contract' check && bun run --filter '@takio/library-store-bun' check && bun run --filter '@takio/desktop' check
scripts.test: cargo test -p takio && bun run --filter '@takio/core' test && bun run --filter '@takio/epub-transform' test && bun run --filter '@takio/library-contract' test && bun run --filter '@takio/library-store-bun' test && bun run --filter '@takio/desktop' test
